agriculture.name: Agriculture
agriculture.flavor: The first furrow is the first calendar.

husbandry.name: Husbandry
husbandry.flavor: A horse is a decision arrived at sooner.

earthenware.name: Earthenware
earthenware.flavor: What the jar keeps, the year forgets.

sailing.name: Sailing
sailing.flavor: The shore stops being the edge of the world.

mining.name: Mining
mining.flavor: The hill is asked what it is made of.

theWheel.name: The Wheel
theWheel.flavor: Nobody expected the circle to be useful.

letters.name: Letters
letters.flavor: A thought that outlives the mouth it came from.

divination.name: Divination
divination.flavor: We question the sky, and learn the habit of questions.

stonecraft.name: Stonecraft
stonecraft.flavor: Stone remembers longer than any of us.

bronzeWorking.name: Bronzeworking
bronzeWorking.flavor: Two soft metals agree to become a hard one.

siegecraft.name: Siegecraft
siegecraft.flavor: A wall is only a promise about time.

irrigation.name: Irrigation
irrigation.flavor: Water is taught where to go.
irrigation.note: A farm standing beside fresh water feeds its city better than it did.

wayfinding.name: Wayfinding
wayfinding.flavor: The stars are a coastline nobody can move.

epicPoetry.name: Epic Poetry
epicPoetry.flavor: The dead are given a metre, and stop being dead.
epicPoetry.note: When one of your units falls, the nearest city of yours records the loss in verse and gains culture.
deferred: Verse measured against the fallen soldier — a greater loss sung longer — waits until a one-time grant can be sized by the piece that earned it.

currency.name: Currency
currency.flavor: A promise small enough to carry.

kingship.name: Kingship
kingship.flavor: One name at the top of the list, and a list.
deferred: The King List, which would pay a city for the years since it was founded, waits until a city remembers its own founding turn.

theLongCount.name: The Long Count
theLongCount.flavor: A calendar long enough to outlast the people keeping it.

ancestorRites.name: Ancestor Rites
ancestorRites.flavor: The grandfathers are asked, and answer often enough.
ancestorRites.note: Until the rites are kept, renown gathers but no great person will come.

theHighTemple.name: The High Temple
theHighTemple.flavor: A roof high enough that the god has to look down through it.

bronzePanoply.name: Bronze Panoply
bronzePanoply.flavor: A shield is only a wall if it stands beside another.

shipwrights.name: Shipwrights
shipwrights.flavor: A hull is a house that has agreed to be wet.

philosophy.name: Rhetoric
philosophy.flavor: First we ask what a thing is; the asking never stops.

paperMoney.name: Paper Money
paperMoney.flavor: A note that is worth something because everyone agrees it is.
deferred: The Bourse, which would turn a city’s coin into culture every turn, waits for a building that spends gold rather than earning it.

artisanry.name: Artisanry
artisanry.flavor: The guild decides what a thing is worth by how long it took.

mathematics.name: Mathematics
mathematics.flavor: The siege begins as a diagram.

theImperialPost.name: Empire-Building
theImperialPost.flavor: The message arrives before the rumour does.
theImperialPost.note: Roads near your cities cost nothing to keep, every city joined to your capital pays one more gold, and a joined city is a contented one.
deferred: Hammers toward a building your capital already keeps waits until a one-time grant can look at what stands in another town.

theExaminationHall.name: The Examination Hall
theExaminationHall.flavor: The clerk is chosen by the paper, not by the father.
theExaminationHall.note: A realm that is content or well governed is rewarded more generously.

colonialCharters.name: Colonial Charters
colonialCharters.flavor: A city, written down before it is built.
colonialCharters.note: Settlers are trained faster, and every city you found is founded with its charter already granted.
deferred: A city planted far from the capital costing less authority waits for the writ to know how far from home a site is.

theQadisCourt.name: The Qadi’s Court
theQadisCourt.flavor: The judgement is written down, and can be read back.
theQadisCourt.note: A city you have taken by force costs one less authority.

theology.name: Theology
theology.flavor: The library, copied by candlelight, one page a day.
theology.note: The enhancing beliefs open here: a faith may now be deepened as well as spread.

ironWorking.name: Iron Working
ironWorking.flavor: Every age is named for what it kills with.
ironWorking.note: Iron is named at last, and every warrior of yours retools into a sword the moment a seam of it is yours.

education.name: Education
education.flavor: A school is a city’s second memory.

horology.name: Horology
horology.flavor: The hour stops being a guess.

engineering.name: Engineering
engineering.flavor: The river is put to work and does not complain.

theCataphract.name: The Cataphract
theCataphract.flavor: Man and horse, both in iron, both surprised by it.

prospecting.name: Prospecting
prospecting.flavor: The hill is asked again, and this time it answers.
prospecting.note: Workers and explorers may survey a hill they stand on: a turn spent asking the ground what it hides. A rich seam, buried iron, or gems come up as a resource anyone can see; an empty hill is marked surveyed and stays answered. Every survey pays a small assay.

banking.name: Banking
banking.flavor: Somebody else’s promise, kept in a strongroom.

machinery.name: Machinery
machinery.flavor: A crank is a servant that never sleeps.

theAstrolabe.name: The Astrolabe
theAstrolabe.flavor: The sky is held at arm’s length and measured.

theSilkRoad.name: The Silk Road
theSilkRoad.flavor: No one walks all of it; the cloth does.
theSilkRoad.note: One more caravan may be on the road at once.

feudalism.name: Castellany
feudalism.flavor: Everyone kneels to someone and calls it order.
deferred: Defenders shrugging off arrows waits until a strength line can be told which weapon it is answering.

theHolyOffice.name: The Holy Office
theHolyOffice.flavor: The question is asked, and it is not really a question.

steel.name: Steel
steel.note: Every soldier of the sword line marches one hex further.

alchemy.name: Alchemy
alchemy.flavor: The stone is never found; everything else is.
alchemy.note: Niter is named, and the first soldier who carries fire may be trained where it is dug.
deferred: The glass bead this closing node pays, and the Magnum Opus it opens for every empire at once, wait for the pass that builds the finish line.

movableType.name: Movable Type
movableType.flavor: One carved character, used a thousand times.
movableType.note: A city joined to your capital is contented by the news that reaches it — and it is contented again if your roads were already famous.

fortification.name: Fortification
fortification.flavor: A wall built by people who have already lost one.
deferred: Towns mending their own walls every turn waits for a rule that heals a city the way a garrison heals.

embark.name: Embark
embark.summary: Workers and settlers may cross coastal water.

riteOfTheHarvest.name: Rite of the Harvest
riteOfTheHarvest.summary: An augur may spend a rite to give a city a citizen.

recastingTheOmens.name: Recasting the Omens
recastingTheOmens.summary: An augur may spend a rite to give back one belief and choose another.

omenReading.name: Omen Reading
omenReading.summary: An augur may spend a rite for beakers now and sharper scribes after.

consecrationOfTheBounds.name: Consecration of the Bounds
consecrationOfTheBounds.summary: An augur may spend a rite to walk a city’s borders outward.

blessingOfArms.name: Blessing of Arms
blessingOfArms.summary: An augur may spend a rite to heal a unit whole and send it out stronger.

thePreaching.name: The Preaching
thePreaching.summary: An augur may spend a rite to preach, spreading your religion for a while.

riteOfPlenty.name: Rite of Plenty
riteOfPlenty.summary: An augur may spend a rite for coin now and richer seams after.

ancestorRites.name: Ancestor Rites
ancestorRites.summary: Great people will answer your renown and come to serve.

militaryEmbark.name: Sea Legs
militaryEmbark.summary: Soldiers may cross coastal water as workers and scouts do.

siege.name: Siege
siege.summary: Your armies that surround a town cut it off: it cannot heal, and it loses a little health each turn.

theLongCount.name: The Long Count
theLongCount.summary: The next age’s glass beads are shown a turn before that age opens.

oceanGoing.name: Open Ocean
oceanGoing.summary: Ships and embarked units may cross the deep ocean.
